body:
Someone keeps the obligations and the refusals from ever attending the same meeting.

Duty runs their days, refusal runs their nights, and they keep adjusting the border between the two shifts.

With Saturn quincunx Lilith, people schedule what is owed with one hand and guard what was never agreed to with the other.

The two jurisdictions never negotiate directly, so the person in the middle patrols the border instead of settling it.

The double schedule may hold for years, but the border patrol is a third job, and nobody is paying for it.
